classification: AI-assisted analyst stress ranges, not issuer guidance, historical confidence bands or the human locked exercise

space_growth.label: Space-systems growth shift
space_growth.unit: percentage points added to each 2027-2030 rate
space_growth.basis: Base growth 25/22/18/15%; +/-5 points is a bounded interior challenge relative to the wider combined scenario paths in revenue_assumptions.json. Backlog does not validate these rates.
space_growth.challenge: Compounding amplifies a repeated rate shift; revenue timing may be correlated with margin/capacity.
space_growth.change_evidence: Dated delivery acceptance, funded order conversion and capacity evidence.
space_growth.causal_link: Revenue changes segment profit, revenue-linked SG&A and working capital; 2030 sales/margin/capital anchors then affect the long-term DCF.

space_margin.label: Space-systems gross-margin shift
space_margin.unit: percentage points added to each 2027-2030 margin
space_margin.basis: Base margins 34/35/36/37%; +/-3 points challenges utilization/mix within the broader scenario envelope. These are analyst bounds, not a demonstrated historical band.
space_margin.challenge: A margin shift changes production costs and associated inventory/liabilities, not just EBIT.
space_margin.change_evidence: Repeatable segment unit costs, product mix and program cost-to-complete revisions.
space_margin.causal_link: Gross profit changes EBIT, operating taxes, cost-linked working capital and FCFF, then the transition anchor.

rd_scale.label: R&D spending scale
rd_scale.basis: Base spending 350/360/375/390m; standard +/-10% tests budget variance. Alternative +/-20% deliberately stresses a larger overrun/reallocation, not management guidance.
rd_scale.challenge: Holding revenue fixed isolates cost exposure; cutting R&D could impair future products. A cost-only saving is not an implementable recommendation.
rd_scale.change_evidence: Engineering staffing, technical milestones, grants and credible program budgets.
rd_scale.causal_link: Expense changes EBIT and cash taxes/FCFF; earnings retained in cash/equity; revenue is deliberately fixed for attribution.

neutron_scale.label: Neutron recognized-revenue scale
neutron_scale.basis: Base recognition-equivalents 1/3/6/10 at $50m each; +/-50% reflects weakly evidenced commercialization, within the broad low/high scenario envelope. Narrow +/-10% is a comparison assumption, not evidence that uncertainty is small.
neutron_scale.challenge: Fractional equivalents are revenue-recognition units, not launch counts. Fixed R&D/commercial overhead/capex stay in place; capacity interactions require combined scenarios.
neutron_scale.change_evidence: Qualified hardware, reliable cadence and signed contract recognition schedules.
neutron_scale.causal_link: Revenue and contribution rise/fall while fixed development/commercial costs remain; SG&A and working capital respond, affecting EBIT, FCFF and value.

ranking_method: For each range set, change one driver at a time around the same base. Rank by absolute high-to-low outcome span separately for 2030 EBIT, 2030 FCFF and conditional USD/share. No probabilities, unit-comparable elasticities or universal importance claim.
valuation_control_bounds: WACC 3%-30%, terminal growth 0%-8%, mature margin 4%-40%, marginal return 5%-40% are broad diagnostic limits, not empirical historical bands. Require growth below both WACC and return; funding/continuity checks remain locked. Reference underwriting uses the narrower documented WACC 14%-20% and growth 2%-4% grid.
